name: polymorphic-dispatch
before:
# %%
Shape := [Circle(F64)].{ area = |s| match s { Circle(r) => r * r } }
Other := [Square(F64)].{ side = |s| match s { Square(x) => x } }
measure = |shape| shape.area()
c = Shape.Circle(2)
out_area = measure(c)
# %%
out_side = Other.Square(3).side()
after:
# %%
Shape := [Circle(F64)].{ area = |s| match s { Circle(r) => r * r * 3 } }
Other := [Square(F64)].{ side = |s| match s { Square(x) => x } }
measure = |shape| shape.area()
c = Shape.Circle(2)
out_area = measure(c)
# %%
out_side = Other.Square(3).side()
